name: ATS Jobs Scraper
title: ATS Jobs Scraper: Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday & More
uses: Job boards and newsletters pulling fresh openings from Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters and Workday
Sales teams using hiring as a buying signal for target accounts
Recruiters and job seekers monitoring new roles at a company list every day
AI agents answering who is hiring for a role, with salaries and remote type

inputs.name: companies
inputs.title: Companies
inputs.description: One per line: a company board name (stripe, openai), a careers page URL (https://jobs.lever.co/palantir, https://nvidia.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/NVIDIAExternalCareerSite) or a company website (figma.com). The ATS is detected automatically.

inputs.name: keywords
inputs.title: Keywords (title or description)
inputs.description: Keep only jobs whose title or description contains any of these words. Leave empty for all jobs.

inputs.name: titleKeywords
inputs.title: Title keywords
inputs.description: Keep only jobs whose title contains any of these words, e.g. engineer, sales.

inputs.name: locations
inputs.title: Locations
inputs.description: Keep only jobs whose location contains any of these, e.g. New York, Remote, Germany.

inputs.name: postedWithinDays
inputs.title: Posted within (days)
inputs.description: Keep only jobs posted in the last N days. Great for daily new-job monitoring. Jobs without a date are kept.

inputs.name: withSalaryOnly
inputs.title: Only jobs with a salary
inputs.description: Keep only jobs where a salary range was published or found in the description.

inputs.name: atsPlatforms
inputs.title: Limit to ATS platforms
inputs.description: Optional. Only look on these platforms.

inputs.name: includeDescription
inputs.title: Include full job description
inputs.description: Adds plain-text and HTML descriptions. Turn off for faster, smaller runs.

inputs.name: maxJobsPerCompany
inputs.title: Max jobs per company
inputs.description: Cap on jobs returned per company.

inputs.name: maxJobsTotal
inputs.title: Max jobs total
inputs.description: Stop after this many jobs across all companies. 0 means no limit.

inputs.name: includeSummary
inputs.title: Add a free summary row per company
inputs.description: One uncharged row per company with the detected ATS, board name and job count.

description: Get every open job from company career sites on Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters and Workday in one clean JSON schema.
